data.creator_notes:
An attempt to replicate the MVOL visual novel game in chatbot form. By tracking and updating the same values that are used in game to determine dialogue this bot can mostly replicate the feel of the game (It is a chatbot though so dont expect Lithier Level writing)

To be more detailed it "tracks" 4 different stats and should have their values effect generated dialogue similar to how the actual game only gives you certain scenes when a specific value is at a threshold.

The values here are:
Trust: How much LITH trusts you the user, Should be easy to imagine how you could raise or lower this
Arousal: Lith's Arousal, Self explanatory
Purity: Lith's purity. If its a positive high number then hes a good boy thats pure, if its a low negative number then you've managed to turn him into a little deviant with sex on the brain 24/7
User Naughtiness: How horny you've been to him, If ya get this real high he wont be expecting you to do anything but be horny. if you keep it low you should be able to have some nice deep conversations about his person, if you keep it high then the only deep he'll be thinking about has nothing to do with personality

Assuming Janitor AI's model is able to correctly interpret and use these values then you should be able to play around with them quite alot. I've hard-prompted in some specific things that happen at value thresholds but the hope is that the ai will make up some of its own. Stuff like a medium horny lith with a low trust in you not directly asking for sex but a very horny lith with low trust in you asking anyways or lith becoming very dominant under rare circumstances like in the actual game.

this chatbot is nice but the actual game lith is from is FREE and playable, its better written than this bot could do and has alotta things i didn't write in. If you ain't played it and somehow fount this bot then go play it! its a really well written game and has a shocking amount of dialogue for all the various ways you toy with lith
